title: Certify one query of an incremental SMT-LIB script
summary: The exporter now certifies one check-sat query of an incremental SMT-LIB script, replaying push, pop, reset, and reset-assertions and adding the query's assumptions as hypotheses. The certificate records the query index, the reconstructor rebuilds the snapshot from the original script, and five z3test regressions are certified verbatim in Lean.
